 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Locate the large central colored region (all colors except the outer background pattern).
    # The task removes the repeated-color 3x3 patches that interrupt the center motif,
    # restoring the underlying pattern as determined by the surrounding 6/7 motif.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    n=len(g)
    # In these examples the outer ring is a distinct symmetric frame. The interior
    # pattern is symmetric about the center; repair cells at the left edge of motif
    # using reflected counterparts on the right, where those are unaffected.
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n//2):
            if g[r][c] != g[r][n-1-c]:
                # use symmetry to correct the anomalous patch
                g[r][c]=g[r][n-1-c]
                g[r][n-1-c]=g[r][c]
    return g
"
